decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: 2L JLC2313_1.6, single-sided SMT (USB-A THT); 2 oz fallback
decisions.why: small 5 V/1 A board; unattended delegate

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: one schematic agent, two sheets charger + boost
decisions.why: small board

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: charger BQ24074RGTR, boost TPS61023DRLR
decisions.why: OUT regulated 4.4 V so boost never passes USB through; TPS61023 cheap, 3.7 A limit, JLC stock

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: USB-A D+/D- shorted by 0R (DCP)
decisions.why: BC1.2 DCP; one part; Apple dividers fail BC1.2

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: Vout 4.95 V (732k/100k)
decisions.why: stays in 4.75-5.25 V across tolerance

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: ICHG 1 A (RISET), ILIM 1.5 A, TS fixed 10k, no NTC
decisions.why: brief 1 A; same as reference; cells <1000 mAh need RISET raised

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: DONE LED via one NMOS gate=CHG source=PGOOD; LOW-BATT 3.2 V detector drives LED + LBO pin
decisions.why: BQ24074 has no done pin; TPS61023 has no LBO

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: EN 100k pull-up (on by default); header GND,BAT,VS,5V,LBO,EN,GND
decisions.why: matches reference pinout

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: no PTC/eFuse on 5V, no reverse-battery FET, silk polarity warning only
decisions.why: delegate answer Q9; same as reference; safety-relevant for owner review

decisions.what: research task block-boost-1 closed over 2 unverified draft record(s): boost-fb-divider-and-feedforward, boost-thermal-copper-and-vias
decisions.why: --accept-drafts: the slot ships without this knowledge

decisions.what: research task block-linear-charger-power-path-1 closed over 4 unverified draft record(s): linear-charger-ilim-iset-programming, linear-charger-pin-caps-ts-and-leds, linear-charger-single-point-ground-and-current-paths, linear-charger-thermal-dissipation-and-pad
decisions.why: --accept-drafts: the slot ships without this knowledge

decisions.what: Closed both P2 research tasks --accept-drafts (6/12 verified, 6 refuted drafts stay draft and do not inject)
decisions.why: budget; refutations are numeric corrections carried as the decision below, not wrong rules

decisions.what: Design corrections from the second read: TPS61023 VREF 580/595/610 mV (PWM) for the FB divider tolerance; BQ24074 size ILIM/ISET with KILIM max 1720 (I = K/R); bq24074 VIN range 4.35-10.2 V (VOVP 10.2-10.8 V); TPS61023 RthJA 142.7 C/W -> ~0.3-0.55 W loss is a 43-78 C rise on 2L, so give U2 a GND pour and vias; ISET pads need no dedicated vias
decisions.why: second reader refutations, research/records

decisions.what: designing under coverage gap: block:B1 linear-charger-power-path and block:B2 boost (checklists + 6 records still draft after second read)
decisions.why: first research pass on these topologies; verified records (boost hot-loop, sw-node, inductor, caps, enable; charger DPM) guide layout by judgement

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: low-battery detector MSXC61CN3302MR C45367187 (3.3 V, not 3.2 V; releases ~3.45 V)
decisions.why: no stocked 3.2 V open-drain detector; 3.3 V warns a little earlier, harmless

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL: RILIM 1.2k Basic (1.25-1.43 A) and RISET 1k Basic (~0.89 A) instead of 1.15k/910R Extended
decisions.why: two fewer extended-part fees; lower charge current is kinder to small cells; still about 1 A

decisions.what: bq24074 pins: no SYSOFF/TD; ITERM open (10 %); EN2->SYS, EN1 and CE->GND (never float); TS 10k to GND; RTMR 51k (6.8 h)
decisions.why: part-sourcer read SLUS810N pin table; corrects architect's from-memory notes

decisions.what: U1 BQ24074RGTR stock thin (417), same-die alternates RGTT C2861252 / RGTRG4
decisions.why: recheck before any order

decisions.what: designing under coverage gap: P3 coverage gaps=2 (blocks B1 charger, B2 boost); mapper/auto-research skipped under budget; 6 draft research records unverified
decisions.why: budget-limited run; datasheet layout sections extracted into parts/*.json layout_notes; screen passes

decisions.what: J4 swapped C18077685 -> C53207796 Type-A-AF90 (JXTCONN USB-A THT right angle, stock 180)
decisions.why: C18077685 not in EasyEDA API: no pullable symbol/footprint

decisions.what: Single flat sheet kicad/PCB-0021-A_lipo-boost.kicad_sch (gen: kicad/gen/lipo_boost.py); header J3 = GND,VBAT,+SYS,+5V,LBO,EN,GND; J2 pin1=+; ITERM open; U2 gets extra 100nF C14 (reg_input HF cap); JST tabs and J1 D+/D-/ID NC
decisions.why: sheets.md two-sheet plan was provisional; flat is simpler and ERC/audit clean

decisions.what: PROVISIONAL delegate: rotate U2 270, rotate L1 180, nudge C10/C11 to un-sandwich SW pin; place gate re-passed
decisions.why: SW pin was the middle pin of its column and crossed FB on 2 layers

decisions.what: J4 rotated 270->90 (constraints placement.edges rot updated); mouth 0.25 mm inside the right edge, not overhanging
decisions.why: owner (JLC 3D preview): plug could not enter, mouth faced L1. Flush-but-inboard keeps J4 mouth-end silk off Edge.Cuts; plug enters above the board so 0.25 mm inset does not obstruct it

edits.note: J4 USB-A mouth faced into the board toward L1 (rot 270); rotated to 90 so it opens at the right edge, mouth 0.25 mm inboard; R12/Q1/D1 moved out of its pin field
re-routed with route_edit after the J4 rotation (kicad/route19, route20 ops)
